decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks fit closely with the firm’s dental materials and thermoforming know-how, so its existing knowledge base and channels make early learning and improvement relatively easy.
A PETG thermoforming blank is highly related to the firm’s established laboratory materials and process expertise, making it a natural extension with strong absorptive-capacity support.
UV-curing lacquer is still related to the firm’s materials competence, but its weaker website presence suggests a more tentative market position and a somewhat higher risk of withdrawal.
Intraoral contrast spray supports digital clinical workflows that match the firm’s strategic shift toward digital manufacturing, so management would likely retain it and refine it.
A custom earmold line builds on the firm’s custom-device manufacturing and hearing-care customer base, giving it enough related knowledge to justify continued commercialization.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are adjacent to the firm’s earmold and hearing-care capabilities, but as a narrower extension they carry a somewhat higher chance of being rationalized if uptake is modest.
